items.title: Room Booking Core Functionality
items.description: Provide users with searchable room availability, booking, and enforcement of no double‑booking.

items.title: Administration & Access Controls
items.description: Enable facilities staff to manage rooms and view bookings while restricting user visibility.

items.title: View available rooms
items.description: As a student or staff member, I want to see which study rooms are free, so that I can choose a suitable room.

criteria.text: When a user searches for a date and time, the system lists all rooms that have no booking for that period.

citations.quote: Let students and staff see which study rooms are free

items.title: Book a room
items.description: As a student or staff member, I want to book a one‑off room slot, so that I have a guaranteed space for my study session.

criteria.text: When a signed‑in user selects a room, date, time, and duration (≤4 hours), the system creates a booking if the slot is free.

citations.quote: Students and staff sign in with their existing college account
search rooms by date, time and capacity, and book an individual one‑off slot
A booking can last up to 4 hours

criteria.text: If the requested slot overlaps an existing booking for the same room, the system rejects the request and displays an error.

citations.quote: reject an overlapping booking for the same room

items.title: Facilities view of all bookings
items.description: As a facilities staff member, I want a single view of all room bookings, so that I can manage usage and maintenance.

criteria.text: When the Facilities Office accesses the admin dashboard, it shows every room with all current bookings and blocked periods.

citations.quote: Give the Facilities Office a single view of all bookings
The Facilities Office can block a room for maintenance

items.title: Block rooms for maintenance
items.description: As a facilities staff member, I want to block a room for maintenance, so that it cannot be booked during that period.

criteria.text: When a facilities staff member marks a room as blocked for a time range, the room no longer appears in availability searches for that range.

citations.quote: The Facilities Office can block a room for maintenance

items.title: Hide booking owner from regular users
items.description: As a student or staff member, I want to see only that a room is taken, not who booked it, so that privacy is maintained.

criteria.text: When a regular user views room details, the system shows the room status as 'Booked' without revealing the user name.

citations.quote: Students should only see that a room is taken, not who took it

items.title: Enforce maximum booking length
items.description: As a facilities staff member, I want a maximum booking length enforced, so that rooms are not hogged.

criteria.text: When a user attempts to book longer than the allowed maximum, the system rejects the request with an appropriate message.

citations.quote: A booking can last up to 4 hours
three hours is the most I want for a single booking

open_questions: What is the final maximum booking duration: 3 hours or 4 hours?

items.title: Cancellation and no‑show handling
items.description: As a facilities staff member, I want rules for cancellations and no‑shows, so that unused rooms can be released.

criteria.text: When a user cancels within the defined window, the slot becomes available for others; if the user does not show up, the system follows the agreed no‑show rule.

citations.quote: We need a rule for no‑shows, and for how late someone can cancel

open_questions: What is the allowed cancellation window and no‑show policy?

questions.subject: Maximum booking duration
questions.question: Should the system enforce a maximum booking length of 3 hours or 4 hours?
questions.why_it_matters: The brief states 4 hours, but the Facilities Manager prefers 3 hours to prevent room hogging.

citations.quote: A booking can last up to 4 hours
three hours is the most I want for a single booking

questions.subject: Cancellation and no‑show policy
questions.question: What cancellation deadline and no‑show handling rule should be applied?
questions.why_it_matters: The policy affects room utilization and fairness, but it remains undecided.

citations.quote: We need a rule for no‑shows, and for how late someone can cancel

items.title: Campus Room Booking System
items.description: Provides students and staff a self‑service way to view and reserve study rooms while giving Facilities a management view.

items.title: User sign‑in
items.description: As a student or staff member, I want to sign in with my college account, so that I can access the booking system.

criteria.text: When a user enters valid college credentials, they are authenticated and taken to the dashboard.

citations.quote: Students and staff sign in with their existing college account.

items.title: Search and one‑off booking
items.description: As a user, I want to search rooms by date, time and capacity and book an individual one‑off slot, so that I can reserve a suitable study room.

criteria.text: Search returns a list of rooms that are free for the requested date, time and capacity.

citations.quote: A user can search rooms by date, time and capacity, and book an individual one-off slot.

criteria.text: Booking a displayed room creates a booking record and marks the slot as unavailable.

citations.quote: A user can search rooms by date, time and capacity, and book an individual one-off slot.

items.title: Prevent double bookings
items.description: As the system, I want to reject overlapping bookings for the same room, so that double bookings are prevented.

criteria.text: If a booking request overlaps an existing booking for the same room, the request is denied and the user sees a message "Room unavailable for the selected time".

citations.quote: ending double bookings. If two people can take the same room at the same time, we have failed.
reject an overlapping booking for the same room.

items.title: Block rooms for maintenance
items.description: As the Facilities Office, I want to block a room for maintenance, so that it cannot be booked during that period.

criteria.text: When a room is marked as blocked for a time range, it does not appear in user search results for that range.

citations.quote: The Facilities Office can block a room for maintenance.

items.title: Facilities admin view
items.description: As the Facilities Office, I want to see who booked each room, so that we have an audit view while students only see that a room is taken.

criteria.text: Admin users can open a report that lists each booking with the user’s identity.

citations.quote: office needs to see who booked each room. Students should only see that a room is taken, not who took it.

criteria.text: Standard users see only a status indicator (e.g., "Booked") without any user details.

citations.quote: Students should only see that a room is taken, not who took it.
